facts.fact: US retail sales are expected to reach $7.41 trillion USD in 2024, according to EMARKETER as cited on the page.
facts.quote: US retail sales will reach [$7.41 trillion USD in 2024]

facts.fact: The US retail market is projected to have an annual growth rate between 2.9% and 3.1% through 2028.
facts.quote: the US retail market is projected to have an annual growth rate between 2.9% and 3.1% through 2028

facts.fact: The pre-pandemic average annual US retail growth rate was 3.6% per year, according to NRF as cited on the page.
facts.quote: close to the pre-pandemic average of [3.6%]

facts.fact: US online (e-commerce) sales were projected to reach nearly $1.5 trillion USD in 2024.
EMARKETER forecasts e-commerce will account for 20% of total US retail sales by 2028.
facts.quote: with e-commerce accounting for 20% of total US retail sales by 2028

facts.fact: According to NRF, 70% of retail sales still occur in person.
facts.quote: with 70% of retail sales still occurring in person

facts.fact: The National Retail Federation describes retail as delivering the right product at the right price to the right customer.
facts.quote: retail is, at its core, about delivering “the right product at the right price to the right customer.”

facts.fact: Off-site retail media, including display ads on third-party websites, digital signage, and CTV, accounted for 18.5% of all US retail media ad spend in 2024, according to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: accounting for [18.5%](https://www.emarketer.com/content/retail-share-digital-advertising-sell-vs-buy-side) of all US retail media ad spend in 2024

facts.fact: Dynamic retargeting uses data from browsing behaviour, abandoned carts, or previously viewed product pages to automatically tailor ads to the specific products or content a user is interested in.
facts.quote: leverages data captured from browsing behaviour, abandoned carts, or previously viewed product pages to automatically tailor ads

facts.fact: Contextual targeting places ads based on the content a potential customer views rather than on browsing history or personal data, using keywords, topics, and other contextual signals.
facts.quote: places ads on websites or apps based on the content viewed by a potential customer rather than relying on a user’s browsing history or personal data

facts.fact: Footfall attribution connects ad impressions to actual store visits and can be used to measure the cost per store visit.
facts.quote: is a method used to connect impressions to actual store visits
